title: Allowed IP ranges: an administrator can exclude their own address unwarned, and clearing the field does not take effect until a restart
body:
epic:#26676#1 · zhuangjianguo · session_cdb7a717def74e719988f089fbaa18ff

From a real-user walkthrough of Setup, filed on the maintainer's word: 「以上都同意，立卡」 (2026-11-05). Measured on `main` `b7075d9908`, with the console in dev mode, unless a line says otherwise. Test app scaffolded with `create-objectstack@18.3.0`.

## What a customer sees

A company wants sign-in only from the office. The administrator, working from home, enters the office range and saves. Nothing says their own address is outside it. They find out on the next sign-in. If they still have a page open and clear the field, the page says saved, and sign-in keeps being refused until someone restarts the server. A business administrator cannot do that and has no way to tell why it did not work.

## Measured

- `allowed_ip_ranges = 203.0.113.0/24` from `::1`: toast 「设置已保存」, no warning, the current address is not shown. `POST /api/v1/auth/sign-in/email` then answers 403 `IP_NOT_ALLOWED`.
- The open session keeps working, so the field can still be edited.
- Field cleared and saved: toast 「设置已保存」, the stored value is empty, and sign-in still answers 403 on three tries over 12 seconds. `/api/v1/auth/two-factor/enable` was refused the same way.
- After a server restart: sign-in 200.

## Likely cause, from reading the code

`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-plugin.ts:2062` applies a setting to the running config only when `isExplicit(key)`, and `:2292` does so for this key. A cleared value appears to read as `default`, so the old list stays in force. If so, other settings with an empty or restored-default state may behave the same; 恢复默认 was not measured.

## Expected

- The field shows the caller's current address. A list that excludes it is refused or asks for explicit confirmation.
- Clearing applies at once, as saving a value does.
- The documentation says how to recover when locked out. The seat found no environment variable for this key in `content/docs/deployment/environment-variables.mdx`.
